summary: A five-story, roughly 222,000 sq ft commercial office building at 1401 Third Street in Mission Bay South. DataSF's Assessor tax roll (block 8721, lot 032) records the building's construction year as 2009.

milestones.text: SF Dept. of Building Inspection permit #200704279921 filed to erect a 5-story office/lab building at 455 Mission Bay Blvd South, this parcel's address before it was renamed 1401 Third Street
Building completed, per DataSF Assessor tax roll

sources.title: Assessor Historical Secured Property Tax Rolls (block 8721, lot 032 -- 1401 3rd St)

sources.title: Building Permits: permit #200704279921 (455 Mission Bay Blvd South, block 8721 lot 012 at filing -- later renumbered lot 032), filed 2007-04-27, "erect 5 stories office/lab", completed 2008-04-24
sources.publisher: DataSF / SF Department of Building Inspection

open_questions: Developer, architect and current/original tenant not confirmed by any source found in this pass -- consistent with this record's own geometry-file note.
Precise completion month not available; DataSF's Assessor tax roll gives only a year.

The permit's own block/lot (block 8721, lot 012) at filing time differs from the lot the Assessor now uses for this address (lot 032); Mission Bay parcels were renumbered after the original 2000s-era permits were filed, and the address, description (5-story office/lab), scale and 2008-04-24 permit-completion date all line up with this parcel, so this is treated as a lot renumbering, not a different building.
